description: One row per Plinko board/station. Stores station identity, scoring settings, Game Mode, bucket count, and ordered bucket display icon configuration.

columns.description: Primary name for the Plinko station profile.
Stable station slug used by the display query string and Pi landing payload.
Number of physical buckets on this Plinko board.
Grand-prize entries awarded when the puck lands in the currently lit bucket.
Grand-prize entries awarded when the puck lands in any non-lit bucket.
When false, drops are shown on the booth display but no Prize Claim, Plinko Play, QR, or entries are created.
JSON array of ordered bucket icon ids. Supported values: powerapps, dataverse, powerautomate, powerpages, aibuilder, powerplatform. Missing, invalid, or short arrays fall back per bucket.
